conditions: Utah always gets the least favorable of the three picks.
If PHI's pick is the most favorable of the three, BKN gets it (rank 1) and HOU gets rank 2; otherwise HOU gets rank 1 and BKN rank 2.

Mechanics: HOU holds an unprotected swap of its own pick with BKN's (2021 Harden trade); BKN holds PHI's deferred 2023 first and owes UTA the less favorable of PHI's pick and the pick BKN is left with (2022 O'Neale trade).

conditions: Sequential swaps: OKC first takes the better of the OKC and LAC picks (unprotected, Paul George trade); LAC is left with the other. HOU (which holds MIL's unprotected pick) may then swap MIL's pick for the pick LAC is left with; LAC gets the least favorable.
If MIL's pick is the most favorable of the three, HOU keeps MIL's pick (rank 1) and OKC gets rank 2.
HOU's swap is top-6 protected: if the pick LAC is left with (worse of OKC/LAC) lands 1-6, HOU cannot swap; HOU keeps MIL's pick and LAC keeps that pick.

LAC.text: OKC gets the better of OKC/LAC; Houston may swap MIL's pick for the pick LAC is left with (top-6 protected); LAC ends up with the least favorable.

open_issues: Pool BKN/HOU/PHI: the allocation depends on whether PHI's pick is the best of the three (HOU rank 1/BKN rank 2 normally, swapped if PHI is best); ranks alone cannot express this, so the switch is in conditions. Terms agree across HR_aug22, HR_oct22 and HR_mar23.

Pool LAC/MIL/OKC: sequential OKC then HOU swaps; ranks shown are the typical case, with the MIL-best switch and the top-6 protection on HOU's swap in conditions. The top-6 protection is stated only in HR_aug22 (Bucks entry: HOU may swap MIL's pick with LAC's 'top-six protected'); HR_mar23 confirms the sequence (OKC swap first, then HOU) but not the protection -> medium. The trade that gave HOU the MIL/LAC swap right was not identified in the sources checked.
Consistency check: applying each native's rule (including pool conditions) to its realized slot reproduces the realized pre-draft holder for all 30 natives. No mismatches.
Draft-night trades (not mismatches; pre-draft holder recorded): #7 IND<->#8 WAS, #10 DAL<->#12 OKC, #24 SAC->DAL, #25 MEM->BOS->DET, #29 IND->DEN.
No 2023 first-round picks were forfeited; the 2023 forfeitures (CHI, PHI tampering) were second-rounders.
